paper.title: KHNTT: A Configurable and High-Performance Polynomial Multiplication Unit Based on FPGA
paper.version: Final journal issue: IEEE TCAS-I 73(5), May 2026, pp. 3410-3423
paper.verification_scope: Read all 14 pages of the user-provided PDF; visually checked figures and tables. Publisher DOI endpoint was not used to validate full text.
supports: Algorithm and architecture descriptions with section/page/figure locators in the article
Original reported experimental data in metrics.json

code.verification_scope: Static inspection only; no RTL simulation, synthesis, place-and-route or on-board measurement.

locators.supports: Radix-4 transforms and PtNTT test-vector generation; not the identical optimized ten-product flow
Compute counter excludes parameter/twiddle loading states
Fixed q parameter 8380417 and fixed bit-slice reduction in this version
Mode-dependent PE wiring and output delay alignment
Compile-time ring size and data width

independent_analysis.verification_scope: 25 deterministic input cases across five parameter sets check the rewritten four-way identity against independent schoolbook negacyclic multiplication; operation-count and metric arithmetic checks. Not an implementation or security proof.

figure_inventory.subject: Multiplication-count comparison
figure_inventory.reason: The relevant count is derived and numerically recomputed in article section 4.2.

evidence_gaps: No independent revalidation of cited baseline papers
No established all-parameter RTC coverage in inspected code
TP unit and several source numeric/pseudocode inconsistencies
